realReviews.author: Marc Sexton
realReviews.text: Impressed with Guaranteed Construction!  Rodney, the owner, was easy to work with and schedule, and the pricing was very fair and reasonable. Rodney's crew were friendly, professional, and respectful throughout the whole process. They did an amazing job on my deck project, and I couldn't be happier with the outcome. Highly recommend!

realReviews.author: Maria Roy
realReviews.text:
Recently I had the roof done by this young man Rodney Lauffer from Guaranteed carpentry  and roof repair LIC.  He did an excellent work and was completely honest with me. The price was fair taking in consideration everything is very expensive. It is hard to find such trustworthy service these days.
I highly recommend him to anyone.

realReviews.author: Jason Williams
realReviews.text: Great quality and price.  I needed a bunch of repairs all over my roof from years of tree and water damage.  Rodney came and walked me through everything and made me feel at ease.  They completed the work very timely as well.  Very satisfied with the work.  Thank you

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your deck or roof?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written estimate before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about the job.

faq.a: Send the job through the form or call Rodney. We aim to get back to you within 24 hours, look at the job, and send a written estimate.
Bow, Concord and the surrounding area. Tell us where the job is when you get in touch and we'll confirm.

faq.q: Can my deck be repaired, or does it need a rebuild?
faq.a: It depends on the framing. We'll check it properly and tell you honestly whether a repair, a rebuild or a new deck makes sense.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the license and insurance details for your project.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to set a time to look at the job.
